meta.label: List Intune device compliance setting states
meta.description: Retrieve device compliance setting states from Microsoft Intune, aggregated from all deviceCompliancePolicySettingStateSummaries or optionally filtered by summary IDs

params.name: summary_ids
params.label: Device Compliance Summary IDs (Optional)
params.description: List of deviceCompliancePolicySettingStateSummaryIds to filter by. Enter one ID per line. If left empty, all summaries and their setting states will be retrieved.

params.name: query_select
params.label: $select - Select Fields (Optional)
params.description: OData $select parameter: comma-separated list of fields to include in deviceComplianceSettingStates (e.g., 'id,setting,settingName,deviceName,state'). If empty, all fields are returned.
